summary: Overlay triggers need an opt-in ghost variant so header menu triggers match ghost chrome
expected: UiPopover and UiDropdownMenu accept a trigger variant option that reuses the existing shared ui-button ghost classes; the default secondary look is unchanged
acceptanceCriteria: triggerVariant defaults to secondary and the rendered trigger class list is unchanged for existing consumers
triggerVariant ghost renders ui-button--ghost with transparent idle background and the shared ghost hover/press washes
Vue and React adapters expose the same prop name and class output
XCA-Portal header menu trigger uses the ghost variant and its pressed state no longer paints the secondary tone fill

consumers.scenario: The compact header menu button renders as a filled secondary pill with a tinted press state while every neighbouring header control is ghost

resolution: UiPopover 与 UiDropdownMenu 新增 triggerVariant（默认 secondary），Vue 与 React 适配层共用同一变体映射；packages/vue/src/components.test.ts 与 packages/react/src/overlay.test.tsx 覆盖默认值与 ghost 变体；XCA-Portal app/components/site/SiteHeader.vue 以 trigger-variant=ghost 接入紧凑菜单，tests/e2e/mobile-header.spec.ts 校验触发器类名，tests/e2e/site-transitions.spec.ts 校验过渡与层级。
